rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:2.5: can: p527-strip800.jpg system 3, stanza 2's row: capitals alone do not decide it (the moved word follows the full stop printed there, and the next word is a divine pronoun), but the header's metre 8.7.8.7.8.7. (p527-strip0.jpg) gives lines 5 and 6 eight and seven syllables, which the database's lines have in all three stanzas, and the change makes them nine and six. movedown:3.6: can: p527-strip1600.jpg system 4, stanza 3's row: the moved word is a divine pronoun and the next is the first-person pronoun, both capitals anyway, but the header's metre 8.7.8.7.8.7. (p527-strip0.jpg) gives line 6 seven syllables, which it has in every stanza, and the change leaves it six (and the repeat line eight).
